simple.summary: אַלְקוּם (ʼalqûwm) means a non-rising (i.e. resistlessness) First listed occurrence: Prov 30 31.

definitions.full: H510. alqum אַלְקוּם band of soldiers (= Arabic , people ; so E. Castle, Thes etc., compare Che Job & Solomon 175 ; > textual error for אֱלֹהִים Hi compare Now) Prov 30:31 .
